scope: Existing-catalogue literature and status audit. No new problems added and no remote publication.
method: Every local record received a targeted search. Relevant model/theorem/full-text sections were read for selected entries. Neither full-proof verification nor exhaustive forward-citation coverage was performed.

coverage_definitions.theorem/full-text: Relevant primary model/theorem or full-text sections read and compared; not every proof step certified.
coverage_definitions.abstract-only: Primary abstract inspected; theorem assumptions not fully checked.
coverage_definitions.search-only: Targeted searches or indexed material inspected. No finding of continued openness is implied.

update_count_note: 63 records changed, including two metadata-only cleanups. Other changes include literature/status corrections, newer bounds, source/model qualifications, and citation metadata.
